## Why

AC5 of the TCE item requires the implement skill documentation to describe the
pre-push `mirror_suite_cache` capability as behaviour of the canonical pre-push
hook template (the `worklog` package's `PRE_PUSH_HOOK_CONTENT`, emitted by
`wl init` and kept current by `wl doctor upgrade`), not as a repository-local
patch.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `skill/implement/SKILL.md` (step 9 dev-push block) states that the mirroring
   is canonical-template behaviour and that `.githooks/pre-push` must not be
   patched locally.
